title: Boxz Web Code Corpus (line-deduplicated)
licence: MIT (three.js, jQuery) - licence verified via the GitHub API at fetch time
notes: Line-level deduplication of the MIT-licensed web-code slice (three.js examples/*.html, jquery/src/*.js). Built by python -m boxz.data.dedupe_corpus: exact duplicate lines are kept once per document and near-identical documents collapsed, so the model sees varied code instead of 659 copies of renderer.setSize(...).
allowed_use: MIT licensed source code; excerpts redistributed for model training with attribution retained in the manifest.
